podcast.title: Awareness of Bowie's Illness
podcast.body: Donnie MacCalson was among the very few individuals, along with Tony Visconti, who was aware of David Bowie's terminal illness during the recording of Black Star. This knowledge was kept from most other musicians and collaborators. "el único que lo sabía era Donnie Visconti porque era un gran amigo personal de David Bowie pero el resto no lo sabía."

podcast.title: Musical Dominance in Black Star Recording
podcast.body: Donnie MacCalson was a leading jazz musician who musically dominated the band during the recording sessions for David Bowie's Black Star. He spent countless hours in nearly interminable sessions, contributing significantly to the album's complex sound. "musicalmente la banda estaba dominada por el grandísimo Donnie MacCalson, un grandísimo músico de jazz y ellos durante horas a cien sesiones casi interminables."
